note: Workarounds a studio put in its .env that a later harness release made unnecessary. npm run upgrade -- --preflight warns about each one set in the studio's .env once the studio's harness is at that version or newer (harness/upgrade-preflight.mjs, "before a long run"). key: the .env key; value: flagged only when set to exactly this (no value: whenever it is set); version: the release that made it unnecessary; why: what that release fixed and what to do.

leftovers.why: 2.77.3 (H1, B-109): the stall check's read-burn ratio no longer counts cache reads and gives no verdict in the first STUDIO_STALL_GRACE_MIN minutes; 0 still turns the whole check off, so a stalled session runs on. Remove the line.

2.77.3 (M6, C2a): the train gets the next free heavy slot (STUDIO_TRAIN_SLOT_PRIORITY_MIN) and port collisions are named; a fixed slot count overrides the machine budget, so a few slots make verifies queue behind one another (B-117). Remove it unless this PC needs a cap the machine scan can't see.

2.78.1 (B-118): agy stream mode sends the message shape agy accepts (event: "user"); 0 keeps the one-turn launch, whose builders exit mid-task (B-99). Remove the line once the stream hand test passes on this PC.
